def factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60(df):
    """Measure underwater lower-wick absorption with a slower drawdown reference for robust predictive ordering."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    eps = np.finfo(float).eps
    safe_close = close.clip(lower=eps)
    bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    wick_base = np.minimum(open_, close)
    lower_wick = ((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    close_location = ((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    absorption = (lower_wick * close_location).rolling(16, min_periods=16).mean()
    high_water = safe_close.rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().clip(lower=eps)
    depth = (1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0)
    prior_close = safe_close.shift(1)
    downside_damage = (-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum()
    ret = safe_close.pct_change()
    downside_energy = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    total_energy = ret.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_share = (downside_energy / total_energy).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    signal = depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage)
    signal = signal * (1.0 - 0.5 * downside_share)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smoothed_60"]
rationale: Mutates the qualified payoff-first parent by extending only the high-water reference from 50 to 60 sessions. The core mechanism of identifying underwater prices with repeated lower-wick recovery is preserved, along with the existing downside-damage and downside-energy controls that support positive payoff and monotonicity. The slower drawdown context should reduce short-lived depth reversals and improve weak IC and rank stability without adding features or materially increasing turnover.
